asset.name: NetworkGraph
asset.description: The lazily loaded graph visualization with pan, zoom, selection, pluggable layout, minimap, a windowing policy, deterministic interaction, and an accessible structural summary.

requires.reason: Theming, states, and the accessible equivalent are shared.
Pan, zoom, and coordinate handling are the shared spatial surface.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: Determinism is the requirement most force-directed graphs miss: a layout that differs on every render makes the same data unrecognisable between visits and unusable as a reference.
